additional_info.subject: Critical Issue with Siemens SI-ChargeD 180kW at Key Customer - Tamer Logistics
additional_info.body:
Dear
Business
Partner,
Please consider this matter of high importance.
We are writing to address a critical technical issue concerning a defective Siemens SI-ChargeD 180kW unit installed at one of our top strategic clients, Tamer Logistics.
This defect is currently preventing the operation of the charger, consequently impacting the charging capabilities of their four electric commercial vehicles. This disruption is causing operational challenges for Tamer Logistics and is negatively affecting both Electromin's and Siemens' reputation. Ensuring customer satisfaction remains our mutual priority.
The issue was escalated to the Siemens Technical Team on February 22nd. Despite nearly a month of collaborative efforts to diagnose the problem, we have reached a point where the necessary replacement part to re-diagnosis is unavailable within Saudi Arabia and Siemens' central parts depots.
Given the significant sensitivity of this situation and the impact on a key customer, we propose an immediate solution. Electromin intends to replace the defective DC charger with a brand new unit from our existing stock. We respectfully request that Siemens bear the cost of the defective unit. Furthermore, we are prepared to store the defective unit in our warehouse as a potential spare part resource for Siemens' future needs within the KSA market.
We look forward to your
prompt response and confirmation
so that we can proceed with the immediate replacement and mitigate further disruption for Tamer Logistics.
Your swift action in this critical matter is highly appreciated.
Sincerely,
Mowafak AlSaadi
Director of Sales & Marketing
Electromin Ltd Company

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0413396-DC/Si-D/SA-[zin1cf] Critical Issue with Siemens SI-ChargeD 180kW at Key Customer - Tamer Logistics CRM:00798002011
additional_info.body:
Dear Mowafak,
Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention and for your continued partnership. We fully acknowledge the importance of resolving this issue swiftly, given Tamer Logistics’ strategic significance to both Electromin and Siemens.
From the initial fault occurrence where it was due incorrect wiring or faulty component (where its already ordered), Siemens promptly provided technical support and engaged our global technical experts to assist Electromin’s team in diagnosing and addressing the problem. Despite the complex nature of this rare issue, our teams collaborated closely, and the error has been cleared couple of times, but we see its reoccurred again. Specific components have been identified for replacement, and Siemens has initiated the necessary ordering process to secure the parts.
We understand the operational impact on Tamer Logistics and appreciate Electromin’s proactive approach to maintaining service continuity. While Siemens holds no contractual obligation to replace the entire unit, we remain committed to supporting Electromin and its key customers. To that end, Siemens will cover the full cost of the required spare parts for the faulty unit and continue providing technical assistance to ensure the unit remains operational.
Additionally, months back Siemens recommended to Electromin to hold strategic spare parts plan (email reference attached) to safeguard uptime for your VIP customers moving forward — minimizing downtime and ensuring quicker fault resolution in any future scenarios.
We value our partnership and remain dedicated to resolving this matter together.
Please feel free to reach out for any further discussions or clarifications.
Kind regards / Viele Grüße /
مع أطيب التحيات
